## Change

Describe what a show operator or API caller can do after this change.
Link the [tracked issue](https://github.com/tolgraven/tolglow/issues) as `tolgraven/tolglow#<number>` so the cross-repository reference resolves.

## Visual evidence

Attach a screenshot and a short GIF or video showing the feature in use.
For renderer or transport changes, show the observable output, such as captured DMX bytes, an optical fixture scene or a verified device readback.
Identify the build, input scene or fixture and capture environment. Label simulated devices and replayed output.

## Verification

List the tests or measurements run and any remaining hardware or visual qualification.
